title: Killing the 'ash wolf' (which was explicitly not hunting and could be avoided) triggered '(Lys disapproves)' as a bare parenthetical with no number shown; the regard change is only visible by proactively running status afterward, so a companion souring on you is easy to miss entirely.
where: The Vale of Ash / Twin Stones — attack ash wolf
